correctness.rationale: Six distinct finite roots of 4(t²+1)^3+27 imply six I1 rational-source fibers; the local t=∞ orders yield one split I0* fiber and rational elliptic surface. Shioda–Tate and Oguiso–Shioda give torsion-free rank four with D4* height lattice. The explicit four roots r of r³+r+1 supply three further points plus (0,1). On an admissible genus-g hyperelliptic cover they meet only transversely at the point above ∞, are disjoint from zero, and the height formula gives Gram 2I4. Base-change height scaling and determinant ratio give index two. Eliminating unrestricted c0 identifies the generic function field with a rational function field over C(t); no elliptic curve gains new points by a purely transcendental extension. The exact-arithmetic verification script passed, while global claims rest on the stated proofs and classical elliptic surface theorems.
